name: Overwhelm
benefit:
You are considered to be flanking an opponent
 if at least one ally who also has this feat is threatening that
 opponent and the opponent is at least two size categories
 larger than the larger of you or your ally, regardless of your
 actual positioning.
normal:
You must be positioned opposite an ally to
 flank an opponent.
flavor: You can overwhelm large foes with sheer numbers.
